report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with mostly low latency (62-78ms); one 344ms outlier. Traces show successful downstream calls and healthy pool (size=1, idle=1). No errors, no 5xx, no saturation. Healthy telemetry contradicts a fault hypothesis; insufficient evidence to establish any bounded root cause, so hand off.
